object FundQuotaRules {
  // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/aggregates/FundQuota/commands/ReserveSubscriptionQuota
  final class ReserveSubscriptionQuotaRule(hosts: FundQuotaComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, ReserveSubscriptionQuotaParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: ReserveSubscriptionQuotaParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/behaviors/FundQuota.ReserveSubscriptionQuota/rules/QUOTA_AMOUNT_RANGE
      if ((p.amount < state.minPurchase || p.amount > state.maxSingleLimit)) Left(iMadzError("QUOTA_AMOUNT_RANGE", "QUOTA_AMOUNT_RANGE"))
      // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/behaviors/FundQuota.ReserveSubscriptionQuota/rules/QUOTA_FUND_CAP
      else if (((state.fundTotalUsed + p.amount) > state.fundTotalCap)) Left(iMadzError("QUOTA_FUND_CAP", "QUOTA_FUND_CAP"))
      // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/behaviors/FundQuota.ReserveSubscriptionQuota/rules/QUOTA_ACCOUNT_CAP
      else if (((state.accountUsed.getOrElse(p.accountId, BigDecimal("0")) + p.amount) > state.perAccountCap)) Left(iMadzError("QUOTA_ACCOUNT_CAP", "QUOTA_ACCOUNT_CAP"))
      else Right(List(SubscriptionQuotaReserved(p.accountId, p.amount)))
    }
  }

  def checkEventPostconditions(events: List[Event]): Option[iMadzError] =
    events.iterator.map(checkEventPostcondition).collectFirst { case Some(error) => error }

  private def checkEventPostcondition(event: Event): Option[iMadzError] = event match {
    case e: SubscriptionQuotaReserved =>
      if (Option(e.accountId).forall(_.trim.isEmpty)) Some(iMadzError("FUND_QUOTA_SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA_RESERVED_ACCOUNT_ID_EMPTY", "SubscriptionQuotaReserved.accountId must not be empty"))
      else None
    case _ => None
  }
}
